description: Convert frequency (Hz to THz) and see the matching period in seconds, ms, µs and ns — T = 1/f.

faqs.a: The period T and frequency f are exact reciprocals: T = 1/f. A 50 Hz signal has a period of 1/50 = 0.02 seconds (20 ms).
faqs.q: How are frequency and period related?

faqs.a: Yes — all frequency units are exact powers of ten, so conversions are exact. The period row is computed as the reciprocal and rounded for display.
Hz (hertz) is the SI unit of frequency: one cycle per second, named after Heinrich Hertz.

howto: Pick the frequency unit you are converting from.
Read the value in every frequency unit plus the exact period in s, ms, µs and ns.
